kernel_split_finding.observation: 0.29 log: 'Using HummingLinearKernel for CompressedTensorsWNA16' AND 'Using MarlinLinearKernel for CompressedTensorsWNA16' (two instantiations)
kernel_split_finding.mechanism: CUDA platform kernel priority list _POSSIBLE_KERNELS tries MarlinLinearKernel BEFORE HummingLinearKernel; Marlin accepts int4 (embed_tokens/lm_head, g64) and rejects int3 (main body g128) which falls through to Humming. Checkpoint has actorder=null everywhere (g_idx keys: 0), so has_g_idx is NOT the discriminator.
kernel_split_finding.old_stack_reference: 0.27.1 overlay used HummingLinearKernel for the whole WNA16 path (step-010 log, single line)
kernel_split_finding.perf_suspect: lm_head is a per-decode-step GEMM (151936x5120 int4); Marlin path is the prime suspect for eager 21.x vs 43 gap. A/B attempt: VLLM_DISABLED_KERNELS=MarlinLinearKernel -> load-time CUDA OOM (humming repack peak for embed/lm_head exceeds 16GB budget with 10.4GB weights resident). Batch-3 must solve repack peak when restoring all-humming semantics (old stack served 204k all-humming -> its repack is leaner).
